sources.title: UFC 331 Results, Bonus Winners, Highlights And Reactions
sources.query: Whats the results of yesterday's ufc
sources.excerpt:
Joshua Van just delivered one of the best performances in recent UFC flyweight history. After getting his UFC flyweight title in less-than-glorious fashion in 2025 after Alexandre Pantoja injured his elbow within 26 seconds of the first fight, Van left no doubt on Saturday night.
In the UFC 331 main event, Van handled Pantoja's relentless grappling and picked him apart in the stand-up exchanges. Van was up on all three scorecards in the final round, but the champion defended his title in dominant fashion. Van didn't get the stoppage, but he did win all five rounds on card and four on the other two en route to a unanimous-decision victory.
Pantoja brought everything he had in his toolbox in an attempt to wrestle his title back from Van, but the champion was ready for everything that came his way. It was a great fight and an even better performance from Van.
The main event battle won the Fight of the Night bonus.
Arman Tsarukyan defeats Mauricio Ruffy via First-Round TKO
Tsarukyan shined bright in the co-main event. With a title shot at 155 pounds likely on the line, Tsarukyan scored a highlight-reel KO victory over Mauricio Ruffy. Two nasty elbows knocked Ruffy unconscious.
There is talk of Justin Gaethje's first defense being a rematch against Ilia Topuria. No one will argue if that is the call, but likewise, we shouldn't hear any complaints if Tsarukyan gets the nod after this win.Tsarukyan took home one of the $100,000 Performance of the Night bonuses.
Here is a look at all of the results and bonus winners from UFC 331.
| Card | Weight Class | Matchup | Winner | Method/Round | Bonus |
| Main | Flyweight title | Joshua Van (c) vs. Alexandre Pantoja | Van | Unanimous Decision - 50-45, 49-46x2 | FOTN - $100K to each fighter |
| Main | Lightweight, 5 rounds | Arman Tsarukyan vs. Mauricio Ruffy | Tsarukyan | KO - Round 1 | POTN - $100K |
Aside from the main and co-main event results, arguably the most memorable finish came from Sean Sharaf. The heavyweight pulled off the biggest upset in UFC history when he shockingly knocked out Gable Steveson in the first round. It was the third-fastest KO in UFC heavyweight history. Take a look.
The other fighters on the car who earned $25,000 bonuses for winning by finish were Joanderson Brito, Ryan Gandra, Marlon Vera and Patricio Pitbull. Here is a look at all of the finishes from UFC 331.

sources.excerpt:
UFC 332 in Salt Lake City is a wrap. Natalia Silva is the new UFC women's flyweight champion. She defeated Wang Cong in a hard-fought five-round battle. Silva started strong and built up a lead. Wang came on late, but couldn't close the gap on the judges' scorecards.
Here's a look at all of the other results. Let's talk UFC 332.
| Natalia Silva vs. Wang Cong - UFC Women's Flyweight Championship | Silva def. Cong by UD (48-47x2, 49-46) |
| Payton Talbott vs. Deiveson Figueiredo | Talbott def. Figueiredo by TKO in First Round |
| Esteban Ribovics vs. King Green | Ribovics def. Green by TKO in First Round |
| Roberto Saldic vs. Khaos Williams | Saldic def. Williams by UD (29-27x2, 29-28) |
| Imanol Rodriguez vs. Alden Coria | Rodriguez def. Coria by KO in First Round |
| Daniel Pinas vs. Andrey Pulaev | Pinas def. Pulyaev by KO in First Round |
| Marcus McGhee vs. Anthony Romero | McGhee def. Romero TKO in First Round |
| Anthony Wint vs. Lucas Armand | Wint def. Armand by TKO in First Round |
| Johnny Walker vs. Mick Parkin | Walker def. Parkin by KO in First Round |
| Jacobe Smith vs. Bruce Whitehead | Smith def. Whitehead by KO in First Round |
| Alexander Hernandez vs. Rafael dos Anjos | Hernandez def. RDA by TKO in Second Round |
| Marvin Vettori vs. Ismail Naurdiev | Naurdiev def. Vettori by UD (29-28x3) |
| Eric Nolan vs. Court McGee | Nolan def. McGee by TKO in Third Round |
Payton Talbott Smashes Deiveson Figueiredo in First Round
The first-round finishes keep going. Talbott blew through a seemingly washed Figueiredo in the first frame. Talbott hurt Figueiredo with the first right hand he landed and it was all downhill from there.
There were a ton of mismatches on this card and this was the latest.
Esteban Ribovics Shakes Off Weight Miss, Stops King Green
Ribovics missed weight by a half pound on Friday, but turned around and stopped Green in the first frame. Green had his moments in the short fight, but a blistering combination from Ribovics led to the finish.
Roman Kopylov Derails Ateba Gautier Hype Train
Wint is the total package. He's got a Mike Tyson flow in combat, but when he has the mic, he's like a UFC version of Brian Dawkins. He wants to fight in 40 days and is a fascinating prospect.
Naurdiev banked two early rounds with inside leg kicks and a huge right hand that hurt Vettori. While the UFC veteran came on toward the end, he could dig himself out of the hole.
